==Usage==
<code><nowiki>{{TikTok|username=|url=|name=|text=|date=|quote=|archivedate=|archiveurl=|archivefile=|nobackup=}}</nowiki></code>

===External links===
<code><nowiki>{{TikTok|username=|name=}}</nowiki></code>

'''Required parameters'''
*{{Para|username}} TikTok handle of author
*{{Para|name}} Author being cited in the linked post. Supports wikilinks.

'''Optional parameters'''
*Backup parameters; see below

===References===
<code><nowiki>{{TikTok|username=|url=|name=|text=|date=|quote=|archivedate=|archiveurl=|archivefile=|nobackup=}}</nowiki></code>

Required parameters
*{{Para|username}} TikTok handle of author, without the "@".
*{{Para|url}} Permanent URL to TikTok post, excluding the <code><nowiki>https://www.tiktok.com/</nowiki></code> portion, as well as the profilelink if applicable.
*{{Para|author}} Author being cited in the linked post. Supports wikilinks.
*{{Para|text}} The title or caption of the post.

Optional parameters
*{{Para|date}} Date the TikTok post was published online. In the format <code>YYYY-MM-DD</code>.
*{{Para|quote}} A short excerpt from the citation for quick reference in the article.

===Backup links===
{{BackupLinkHelp}}

==Example(s)==
<code><nowiki>{{TikTok|username=starwars|name=[[Star Wars]]}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{TikTok|username=starwars|name=[[Star Wars]]}}

<hr />
<code><nowiki>{{TikTok|starwars|video/7200413053182151979|[[Star Wars]]|description=These are your first steps. #ANewHope, #RevengeoftheSith, and #ObiWanKenobi are now streaming on Disney+.|date=2023-02-15|archivedate=20230912134954}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{TikTok|starwars|video/7200413053182151979|[[Star Wars]]|description=These are your first steps. #ANewHope, #RevengeoftheSith, and #ObiWanKenobi are now streaming on Disney+.|date=2023-02-15|archivedate=20230912134954}}

<hr />
<code><nowiki>
{{TikTok|starwars|playlist/Star%20Wars%20Celebration-7219747876384082734|[[Star Wars]]|description=Playlist Star Wars Celebration|archivedate=20240121191515}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{TikTok|starwars|playlist/Star%20Wars%20Celebration-7219747876384082734|[[Star Wars]]|description=Playlist Star Wars Celebration|archivedate=20240121191515}}
